title: Finite shifted Hom into restricted reductions on qcqs spaces
statement: Let X be any finite-type quasicompact scheme over the finite field in [def-fix-six-functor-datum], with no separatedness assumption on its structure morphism. For bounded constructible derived-complete integral K and M, Hom(K[1],Res(Red_m M)) is finite for every m. This is the shifted Hom finiteness input to the constructible Milnor mapping-limit argument.

source.place: Successive coefficient reductions, integral reconstruction, and coherence

proof.text: Shift K in the integral constructible category. Apply integral residue Tor to both inputs, obtaining the finite Tor intervals for their reductions. Use the proved intrinsic_hom_finite from CompactSupportTermHomFinite, which already requires no separated structure morphism. Transport the finite Hom set across the actual scalar extension/restriction adjunction. Empty schemes and zero inputs are included.

theorem integralReduction_shiftedHom_finite_qcqs
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : SixFunctorSpace D)
    (K M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X.obj.left) (m : ℕ) :
    Finite (K.obj⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶
      (sfDerivedReductionRestricted l E X.obj.left m).obj M.obj)
